scope: FloorSet block-level floorplanning plus explicitly budgeted ORFS downstream feedback
decision_rule: Map every real design action to a protocol input, model state or operator, sampler stage, objective, projector, or external evaluator before adding a module. External EDA stages remain external unless matched trainable data exists.

action_sequence.real_action: Synthesize RTL into a gate-level netlist, block hierarchy, standard-cell demand and multi-pin nets.
action_sequence.protocol_visibility: Reduced to block areas, pairwise b2b edges, pin-to-block edges, fixed ports and hierarchy-derived constraints.
action_sequence.gap: FloorSet supplies pairwise b2b edges rather than training labels for true net hyperedges. ORFS can export multi-pin nets, but adding a hyperedge path without matched FloorSet training data would create a protocol shift.
action_sequence.next_action: Retain pairwise training. Revisit hyperedge tokens only after a matched hyperedge-enabled benchmark or a validated external-only adaptation.

action_sequence.real_action: Choose die/core scale, aspect, utilization and the global placement envelope.
action_sequence.protocol_visibility: Target block areas and the reference placement bounding box; FloorSet has no fixed outline.
action_sequence.gap: The global envelope is learned rather than coupled to a user-specified utilization target.
action_sequence.next_action: Strengthen this path only if utilization-constrained cases are added to the protocol.

action_sequence.real_action: Plan and orient IO terminals, ports and their block connections.
action_sequence.protocol_visibility: Fixed pin coordinates and weighted p2b incidence; port direction and model-generated port placement are unavailable.
action_sequence.gap: Pins condition block placement but are not generated or oriented. Direction is absent from the current FloorSet schema.
action_sequence.next_action: Do not generate ports under the current protocol. If direction-aware external designs become a target, add it once to the existing port tokens after a matched probe.

action_sequence.real_action: Place macros or block partitions and select their aspect ratios and orientations.
action_sequence.protocol_visibility: Block centers and aspect ratios are generated; target area is exact. ORFS reference orientation is preserved because orientation is not a FloorSet label.
action_sequence.gap: Position and shape have a native trajectory path. Orientation has no protocol label and no corresponding trained action.
action_sequence.next_action: Keep reference orientation. Add an orientation decision only after matched orientation labels and a routed-PPA probe show that it matters.

action_sequence.real_action: Enforce macro halos, channels, blockages, fixed shapes, preplacement and non-overlap.
action_sequence.protocol_visibility: Fixed/preplaced constraints and overlap are native. Halo and channel geometry are introduced by the external ORFS adapter, not FloorSet.
action_sequence.gap: The model does not observe task-specific halo/channel tokens before generation. A feasible scale-pack layout that exceeded the core was previously replaced by canonical shelf packing, collapsing distinct proposals.
action_sequence.next_action: The external legalizer now rigidly translates a feasible scale-pack layout into the core before shelf fallback and verifies pair identity. Add halo/channel tokens only if halo conflicts remain the measured model failure.

action_sequence.real_action: Repair cluster, multi-instance shape and outer-boundary constraints before signoff.
action_sequence.protocol_visibility: Native cluster, MIB and boundary-coded block fields.
action_sequence.gap: Paths exist, but grouping and MIB evidence is weak and boundary behavior is seed-sensitive.
action_sequence.next_action: Require matched ablations on the existing L1 state and refiner. Reject scalar grouping-weight sweeps and extra typed layers already shown ineffective.

action_sequence.real_action: Construct power distribution networks, rails and straps.
action_sequence.gap: No model state or training target exists.
action_sequence.next_action: Keep PDN external. A PDN-named head would not correspond to a learned protocol action.

action_sequence.real_action: Place standard cells using density, routability and timing objectives around fixed macros.
action_sequence.protocol_visibility: ORFS 3_3_place_gp response after a legalized macro proposal.
action_sequence.gap: A validated global-place response can rank proposals, but the current network has no standard-cell density field.
action_sequence.next_action: First complete matched-flow proposal ranking. Only a validated response may be distilled into the existing L1/L2 path or used as a scoped sampler response.

action_sequence.real_action: Legalize and optimize standard cells after global placement.
action_sequence.next_action: Keep external. Revisit only with a full-netlist or standard-cell-aware protocol.

action_sequence.real_action: Build and buffer the clock tree.
action_sequence.gap: No clock tree or buffering action is represented.

action_sequence.real_action: Assign routing resources, then construct wires and vias while satisfying DRC.
action_sequence.protocol_visibility: ORFS global and detailed routing plus congestion and DRC endpoints.
action_sequence.gap: No routing-capacity grid or detailed-route geometry path exists in the generator.
action_sequence.next_action: Use routed WL, overflow and DRC as independent guards. Do not claim in-model congestion awareness without a validated signal.

action_sequence.real_action: Check timing, power, area and design-rule correctness.
action_sequence.protocol_visibility: Certified post-route ORFS Metrics and DRC artifacts.
action_sequence.gap: No timing or power conditioning exists in the model.
action_sequence.next_action: Keep timing/power/DRC as post-route endpoints and do not infer them from global-place timing.

active_gap_queue.promotion_rule: Promote only if analytical ranking beats p2b on new proposals under fixed NFE/refiner budget and preserves legality.

active_gap_queue.existing_path: L1 structural tokens and refiner energies
active_gap_queue.promotion_rule: Run a matched L1 ablation before adding another structural layer or loss.

active_gap_queue.existing_path: L1/L2 conditioning or bounded sampler feedback
active_gap_queue.promotion_rule: Use one field/token path grounded in a pre-generation feature or one explicitly budgeted test-time response. No scalar routing proxy.

Extend the existing active-edge sparse path with a zero-init geometry relay driven by the current flow state. Require a representation-sensitivity probe and reject any dense per-step typed re-encoding or static-equivalent gate.

active_gap_queue.existing_path: frozen-budget sampler plus post-generation response ranking
active_gap_queue.promotion_rule: Preserve a legal parent, select critical blocks without post-route oracle data, and spend the remaining fixed NFE/refiner budget on a partial trajectory. Report EDA response and legalization cost separately.
Every external candidate/control pair must have distinct TCL hashes and a common route before ORFS. Preserve rigid core translation and retain any unresolved shelf collapse.

Add a normalized desired-outline vector to L0 conditioning and train it on a frozen subset. If feasibility remains zero, add a deterministic outline-manifold fit/projection after exact-area decode. Require outline-feasible fraction improvement beyond refiner-weight-only adaptation while preserving fixed blocks, MIB sharing and exact area.
Requires matched hyperedge training data or an external-only claim.
Requires matched orientation labels and a demonstrated routed-PPA failure.
Requires halo-aware training cases or a frozen external adaptation probe.
